disclosures: SYNTHESIZED fixture (not Owner-produced art); its job is to pin the D1/D2/D3 defect classes, not to imitate art.

Sandbox has no onnxruntime/torch GPU: RT-DETR is stubbed to the TRUE dark-ink bboxes of the drawn bubbles (detector stand-in); the region build, RF-16/RF-17 estimator, quads, angles, reading-order sort and every render byte after the boxes are the REAL production path.
OCR is stubbed to the drawn JP text; translations are the builder's Bengali strings; inpainted.png is the synthesized clean page (rings + art stay, text removed).
text_mask.png is the TRUE synthesized text ink (ground-truth surface for the hand-tool measurement), not the pipeline detect-stage box mask.
The Owner's live burst/diagonal page remains the final visual gate for the B2 merge (Owner re-accept on the same test page).
